'Approved E1 (b)', 'Approved E4', 'F1'–'F6' on H1, X1 and H3–H10 are earlier approval codes, not artboard ids; E1/E4 collide with Events-flow artboard ids E1/E4.
summary: Home is the Today screen (wallet balance card, TGIF card, four service tiles, creators rail), a full-bleed dark For you/Following feed that mixes every content format with interstitial creator and professional cards, a wallet+PIN unlock and tip flow, the content detail page, and a full-screen TGIF reader with a sponsored card. Explore is a near-port of web Explore plus Search, with doors into Events, Professionals (P1, P5) and the new Schools flow (SC1). Backend serves the skeleton (feed list, detail, comments, save, rate, follow, creators, events, search with closest/suggestions) but every money action is a Flutterwave charge, there is no buyer wallet and no transaction PIN, so H14–H18 and H26–H28 depend entirely on the Wallet flow and the provider ruling. There is no ad product at all: no model, placement, serving, tracking, dashboard or billing (NotificationCampaign is an admin push fan-out and Event.featured an unpaid pin), so the TGIF sponsored card and the TGIF-off ad slot are a new XL product. TGIF exists on web as a static, client-only devotional (same five parts as the boards) with a localStorage toggle that hides the card; the boards add reactions, reader counts, share-as-image and an ad, none of which has a backend. Smaller real gaps: no Following feed scope, no content likes or view counting, rate() has no purchase check and can be spammed, search never returns communities and never persists recent searches, and the Explore category chips use the creator taxonomy while web and backend filter on a different list. The navigation change (Home · Explore · Inbox · Wallet · Me, with Communities inside Inbox and Settings under Me) is the largest web-side conflict. The biggest risk is the wallet: every price on these boards is 'Pay from wallet' for every user, which runs into the current custody rule (WAWU must not hold a cashable balance) and needs a ruling before any of the payment rows can be built.
